notes:
Venture 0.26 — terrain following under review

• We are reviewing the quality of terrain following, and it is unavailable in this release while that work is under way. Missions flown at a set height above the takeoff point work as before.

• In the save wizard the Terrain Follow option is greyed out. A mission saved earlier with terrain following on can be flown by setting it to Relative Alt: open it, go through the wizard, choose Relative Alt and save.

• The app chooser no longer flashes up for a moment while an update installs.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
